common.metaDescription: Self-hosted RSS/Atom feed manager and remote MCP server for AI assistants.
common.offlineBanner: You are offline. You can keep reading and make changes; they are sent once you are back online.
common.offlineText: FeedKeeper cannot reach the server right now. Check your connection and try again.

onboarding.subtitle: Create the first admin account to finish setting up this instance.
onboarding.cliHint: Run "npm run setup" on the server instead — either way creates the same first admin account.

feeds.noFeedsFoundOnPage: No RSS or Atom feeds found on this webpage.
feeds.importFailed: Failed to parse or import OPML file.

feeds.renameFolderHint: Click a name to rename it.
feeds.emptyHint: Subscribe to news sites, blogs or podcasts – just enter the website address and FeedKeeper finds the feed.

feeds.markedReadToast: Marked all articles from "{{title}}" as read.

feeds.badgeHint: Unread articles of this feed are added to the number on the app icon. Off by default.

items.noSaved: Nothing saved yet. Tap the star to keep an article, including its full text and images, for good.
items.unreadIgnoredInSaved: Saved articles are shown whether read or not.
items.loadFailed: The articles could not be loaded.
items.allReadHint: You have read everything. New articles show up here as soon as they arrive.

settings.title: Settings
settings.tokensHint: Only needed for clients that can't sign in with OAuth, such as scripts or config files. Treat a token like a password.
settings.tokenCreatedHint: Copy it now — it won't be shown again.
settings.mcpHint: Connect Claude, ChatGPT or another MCP client to your feeds.
settings.mutedKeywordsHint: Articles whose title or snippet contains any of these keywords will be hidden from your feed.
settings.autoReaderMode: Open in Reader View by default
settings.autoReaderModeHint: Automatically extract and display full article content when opening an article.
settings.retentionHint: Automated cleanup of old and read items to optimize disk usage and query performance.
settings.retentionReadDaysHint: 0 = purge immediately once read, default: 30 days
settings.autoCleanupLabel: Enable daily automated housekeeping at 03:00 AM
settings.cleanupSuccess: Cleanup complete: removed {{total}} items. Size: {{before}} MB -> {{after}} MB.
settings.installAppHint: Add FeedKeeper to your home screen or dock as a standalone app.
settings.installAppIos: In Safari, tap the Share icon (via the “…” menu if needed) and choose “Add to Home Screen”.
settings.installAppMacSafari: In Safari, choose File › “Add to Dock”.
settings.avatarHint: JPG, PNG or WebP – cropped to a square and resized.
settings.avatarUnreadable: The image could not be read.
settings.sectionGeneralHint: Theme, language and how articles open.
settings.sectionFiltersHint: Hide articles that mention certain terms.
settings.sectionMcpHint: Connect AI assistants like Claude to your feeds.
settings.sectionUsersHint: Manage the accounts on this FeedKeeper instance.
settings.themeHint: Light, dark or matching your system.
settings.mcpStepToken: Create a token below and copy it.
settings.mcpStepUrl: Add a server with this URL in your MCP client.
settings.mcpStepHeader: Send the token as an "Authorization: Bearer <token>" header.
settings.revokeTokenConfirm: Revoke token "{{name}}"? Clients using it lose access immediately.
settings.mcpOauthTitle: Option 1: Sign in with your account
settings.mcpOauthIntro: For ChatGPT, Claude and other apps with connector support. You don't have to create or copy a token.
settings.mcpOauthStep1: In the app, add a custom connector or remote MCP server with the URL above.
settings.mcpOauthStep2: Sign in to FeedKeeper when asked.
settings.mcpOauthStep3: Choose whether the app may only read or also change your feeds, then confirm.
settings.mcpOauthDone: The app then appears under “Connected apps” below, where you can disconnect it at any time.
settings.mcpTokenIntro: For scripts and clients without connector support.
settings.connectedAppsHint: Apps such as ChatGPT or Claude that signed in to this server. Disconnect one to end its access.
settings.addUserHint: Self-registration is off by default – create new accounts here.
settings.offlineSavedHint: Keeps your saved articles and the newest unread ones, with their images, on this device so you can read without a connection. Changes you make offline are sent later.
settings.notificationsHint: Get a notification on this device when feeds you chose have new articles. Turn it on per feed under Feeds → Edit.
settings.notificationsBlocked: Notifications are blocked for this app. Allow them in your device or browser settings.
settings.notificationsIos: On iPhone and iPad, add FeedKeeper to the home screen first, then open it from there to turn notifications on.
settings.notificationsUnsupported: This browser cannot show notifications from FeedKeeper.
settings.notificationsTestFailed: The test notification could not be delivered.
settings.sectionDevicesHint: Connect the FeedKeeper app on your iPhone or iPad.
settings.devicesHint: Each device has its own access. Revoking a device signs it out right away.
settings.deviceQrAlt: QR code for pairing a device
settings.devicePairHint: Open the FeedKeeper app, choose to add a server and scan this code. Or type the code in by hand.
settings.devicePairExpires: Valid for {{minutes}}:{{seconds}} more minutes, usable once.
settings.devicePairExpired: This code has expired. Add a device again for a new one.
settings.deviceRevokeConfirm: Revoke "{{name}}"? The device will be signed out.
settings.mcpClaudeTitle: Use with Claude Desktop or Cowork
settings.mcpClaudeHint: Add this snippet to your claude_desktop_config.json to connect Claude directly to your feeds.

welcome.title: Let's fill your reader
welcome.intro: Add a website, pick a starter pack or import your subscriptions. Your articles appear here as soon as the first feeds have been fetched.
welcome.packsHint: A handful of well-known feeds on one topic. You choose which ones to keep.
welcome.importHint: Import the subscription file (OPML) that your old reader exported.
welcome.fetchingHint: This usually takes a few seconds. The page updates by itself.

intro.title: A short tour
intro.subtitle: Four things that are good to know. This appears only once.
intro.viewsText: Switch between the list and the newspaper view at the top right.
intro.unreadText: The dot next to the search shows or hides articles you have already read.
intro.starText: The star keeps an article for good, with its full text and images. The star next to the search shows everything you saved.
intro.foldersText: Under Feeds you create folders and sort your subscriptions.

plan.limitedTitle: Your account is limited right now
plan.limitedText: Adding, importing and updating feeds is not included in your plan at the moment. You can still read, export and delete.

security.title: Account security
security.intro: Sign in with a passkey or protect your password with an authenticator app.
security.reauth: Confirm your identity before changing security settings.
security.sendEmail: Confirm by email (accounts without a password)
security.enabled: Authenticator codes are enabled for password sign-ins and linked sign-in providers.
security.scan: Scan this QR code in your authenticator app, or enter the setup key. Then confirm with a six-digit code.
security.saveRecovery: Save these recovery codes somewhere safe. Each works once instead of an authenticator code. They are shown only now; replacing codes invalidates the old ones.
security.failed: Could not confirm this action. Check your entries and try again.
security.lastPasskey: Add another passkey before removing the last one.
security.revocationHint: Changing two-factor authentication signs out other sessions and revokes device and API tokens. Reconnect your apps afterwards.
